Queries.Name: T1 - Domain context
Queries.Description: Standard domain partition sweep targeting the base domain DN for standard AD objects.

Queries.Name: T3 - Full RootDSE Domain Expansion Sweep
Queries.Description: Filtered view: expands to only the naming contexts under the current domain (DNs ending in the domain DN), excluding other forest domains.

Queries.Name: T4 - Full GC Sweep
Queries.Description: Uses Global Catalog to perform forest-wide object discovery via the Partial Attribute Set

Queries.Name: T5 - Full RootDSE Expansion Sweep
Queries.Description: Full view: resolves every naming context across the forest (RootDSE plus the Partitions container), including other in-forest domains, and runs against every partition.
